text_block_list.text: The day before the final day. This took place after I saw an exhausted Sakura Chiyono O home.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: "...Igniting an engine I've never used before, huh?"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Now that's a great declaration.
I've definitely got a newfound respect for her."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Geez, CB-chan...
...Wait, could you be the one?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"The one who whispered such devilish temptations
to our sweet, precious little Chiyo-chan."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Mmm, the moon sure is pretty.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Well! You really are terrible at playing dumb.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"...Even so,
you'll forgive me, won't you?"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
If there is a moment when the world changes,
it's when the moon and stars, which were supposed to move in one direction, carve out an extraordinary orbit.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
And if the hands of the clock were to turn backwards,
and the buttons of the future and past were to be mismatched.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
—If only your Derby,
your Arima Kinen had happened.
If only I could have seen you running with all your might.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I thought that if I could see such a world,
it would give me the ultimate rush.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ......What a selfish child.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm not some mythical Umamusume
who can soar through the heavens, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to see what I want to see, and feeling lonely
when someone goes away...
Is it so wrong to stay a selfish child like that?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Such unfair girls.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
“Do you and Chiyo-chan
even realize that, though?”

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Receiving an invite to the Dream Trophy
must mean that even to others, my running is...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: It's already past midnight...
And the night wore on.

Beyond the summer camp, heading toward the bustling autumn season
where Umamusume shine—
